title: Collection of Information-Rich Type 1 Diabetes Data
brief_summary: The aim of this clinical study was to obtain type 1 diabetes data to identify models for glucose prediction and control and to construct a physiological pharmaco-kinetic/pharmaco-dynamic computer model of a type 1 diabetic person.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diabetes duration \> 5 years
* HbA1c \< or = 7.2%
* CSII treated for \> 3 months
* Capable of being moderately, physically active for 20 minutes

Exclusion Criteria:

* symptoms of diabetic late complications except simplex retinopathy
* pregnancy or nursing
